name: Frosting Optimization and Parameterization
definition: Prismatic Cells: Irregular triangular prisms delimited by six vertices: three from the inner bound $(v_i + \\delta^{in}_i n_i)$ and three from the outer bound $(v_i + \\delta^{out}_i n_i)$ for a mesh face with vertices $v_0, v_1, v_2$. Gaussians are constrained to stay inside these cells.
summary: Frosting Optimization and Parameterization confines 3D Gaussians to prismatic mesh cells via barycentric coordinates, offering explicit budget control and geometric bounds unlike unconstrained Gaussian Splatting.
